complete_original_tension_ledger.averaging_rule: No universal averaging or priority; the bounded conditions and unresolved remainder are mandatory.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Adjudicate the changed obligation, revise the correct object, and bound product exceptions without erasing ancestry.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Historical conformance blocks a legitimate improvement or defect correction.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Unqualified evolution excuses harmful erosion and silently withdraws product guarantees.
tensions.name: Architectural stability versus authorised adaptation
tensions.nature_of_tension: A shared architectural constraint can protect a live promise or entrench an obsolete implementation; drift alone cannot distinguish them.
tensions.side_a_justified_when: Supported observers and reused assurance still rely on the invariant.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: Current consequences or authorised intent invalidate the historic rule, and replacement evidence exists.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: The corpora do not supply a universal threshold between erosion and beneficial drift; the disputed consumer and effect remain contextual.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Negotiate bounded shared interfaces and arbitration; allow explicit exceptions, separate baselines or exit where common authority is absent.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Central authority is invented, queues grow and valid product needs are suppressed.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Incompatible local optima and unsupported exceptions contaminate shared assurances.
tensions.name: Family consistency versus product autonomy
tensions.nature_of_tension: Shared asset invariants can protect products while family-wide approval can prevent legitimate local or independent-owner action.

ESA:ESA-004.bearer: System concepts and cross-component behavioural commitments.
ESA:ESA-004.criterion: Keep the user-visible and developer-facing concepts and essential invariants coherent across decisions, while allowing local variation that does not damage them.
ESA:ESA-004.trigger: Independent decisions would expose incompatible meanings or behaviours to common consumers.

ESME:ESME-C071.bearer: Change requests, affected components and decision responsibilities. People, ownership, documentation, dependency graphs, support policies, releases and archives all matter.
ESME:ESME-C071.criterion: A relevant request or conflict can reach someone able and authorised to decide or explicitly decline.
ESME:ESME-C071.trigger: Multiple contributors or support paths create ambiguity about acceptance, review or incident response.

ESPLE:ESPLE-041.bearer: Organisational reach and participant autonomy bound the family; an ecosystem may not be one controlled product line.
ESPLE:ESPLE-041.criterion: Identify who controls assets, proposals, interfaces and releases; distinguish contractual or negotiated compatibility from internal derivation authority; export bounded interfaces rather than fictitious central control.
ESPLE:ESPLE-041.trigger: Suppliers, open-source participants or independent platform users determine material variation.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: A variation changes a shared interface or relied-on guarantee.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: Local decisions remain within shared consequences, or an independent owner has not delegated authority.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: Legitimate disagreements may remain irreconcilable; technical composition cannot manufacture decision rights.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Start from the actual decision, use appropriate views, and widen on consequential discrepancies or counterexamples.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Every small repair waits for an unattainable complete system model.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Unexamined nonlocal effects are passed off as known independence.
tensions.name: Broad reconstruction versus change-specific understanding
tensions.nature_of_tension: Broader reconstruction can expose hidden coupling but imposes cost and model-maintenance obligations.

ESA:ESA-024.bearer: Inferred architectural structures and behaviours from realised artefacts.
ESA:ESA-024.criterion: Combine appropriate static, configuration, dynamic and human evidence to reconstruct only the architectural facts needed; label extraction scope, ambiguity and unobserved behaviour.
ESA:ESA-024.trigger: Reliable architectural knowledge is missing or an existing description is suspect.

ESME:ESME-C013.bearer: The affected feature and evidence needed for the current decision. Relevant source, executable traces, build descriptions, documents and human knowledge form different evidence views.
ESME:ESME-C013.criterion: The maintainer can answer the consequential change questions and state remaining uncertainty.
ESME:ESME-C013.trigger: A maintainer cannot explain the relevant effect or uncertainty of a proposed intervention.

ESME:ESME-C014.bearer: Program statements, variable criterion and control/data dependencies. Relevant source, executable traces, build descriptions, documents and human knowledge form different evidence views.
ESME:ESME-C014.criterion: The result states the criterion and model and is not represented as an exact minimal slice or a complete account of all real effects.
ESME:ESME-C014.trigger: A consequential comprehension or impact question benefits from model-based relevance beyond a single observed run.

ESPLE:ESPLE-012.bearer: The model represents a declared product family, not every conceivable configuration in the technology domain.
ESPLE:ESPLE-012.criterion: Use the least expressive representation that preserves required distinctions; verify translations and tool support for the actual language level.
ESPLE:ESPLE-012.trigger: The domain requires multiplicity, arithmetic, typed values or constraints not expressible adequately by simple selection.

ESPLE:ESPLE-034.bearer: Evolution preserves or explicitly revises obligations of supported products, not just the newest family model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-034.criterion: Recover candidate features and constraints from multiple artefact types, preserve existing valid domain knowledge and review recovered relations against product intent.
ESPLE:ESPLE-034.trigger: Consolidating variants, repairing stale models or reducing dependence on tacit configuration knowledge.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: Contradictory evidence or consequential uncertainty defeats the local boundary.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: A defensible local question and bounded dependency envelope are sufficient.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: Unknown consumers and incomplete execution traces prevent a universal completeness threshold.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Compare the same obligations over a declared horizon; retain selective commonality and justified exceptions without a universal product-count rule.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: A mandatory common platform absorbs unsupported variation and sunk cost.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Untracked divergence duplicates fixes and loses support provenance.
tensions.name: Reuse investment versus selective reuse or cloning
tensions.nature_of_tension: Shared production can amortise change but may create speculative infrastructure and coordination cost.

ESA:ESA-026.criterion: Compare feasible architectural options, including retaining the present design or a smaller intervention, against the same concerns and assumptions; expose excluded options.
ESA:ESA-026.trigger: A consequential investment or restructuring is being justified.

ESME:ESME-C065.bearer: Deferred liability, prospective demand and revisit condition. A debt item links a concrete design/implementation condition to affected future work and its economic context.
ESME:ESME-C065.criterion: Deferral is an explicit justified choice with a relevant trigger rather than forgotten work.
ESME:ESME-C065.trigger: Future change demand is uncertain, interest is small, or the system may retire before repayment benefits arise.

ESPLE:ESPLE-003.bearer: The family consists of products whose shared domain assumptions warrant coordinated production; code resemblance alone is insufficient.
ESPLE:ESPLE-003.criterion: Admit a new variation only with a product or credible future need, an implementation boundary, an assurance consequence and an identified support cost.
ESPLE:ESPLE-003.trigger: A request to broaden the set of products or selectable behaviours.

ESPLE:ESPLE-036.bearer: Family scope and expected product demand are assumptions in the economic case, not benefits created by writing a model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-036.criterion: Compare lifecycle costs and required outcomes over an explicit horizon; vary demand, reuse rate and maintenance assumptions rather than rely on a universal break-even count.
ESPLE:ESPLE-036.trigger: An investment or continuation decision depends on product-line benefits.

ESPLE:ESPLE-037.bearer: Family scope and expected product demand are assumptions in the economic case, not benefits created by writing a model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-037.criterion: Compare SPLE with clone-and-own, selective component reuse, a modular single product or independent development under the same quality and support obligations.
ESPLE:ESPLE-037.trigger: Choosing or defending shared family production.

ESPLE:ESPLE-057.bearer: Family scope and expected product demand are assumptions in the economic case, not benefits created by writing a model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-057.criterion: Reject universal inadmissibility; compare cloning's immediate adequacy and future synchronisation costs with the actual product-line alternative.
ESPLE:ESPLE-057.trigger: Cloning is rejected without examining portfolio conditions or maintenance obligations.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: Repeated demanded variants and sustainable support make common assets worthwhile.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: Demand is uncertain, needs conflict or the adequate independent route costs less.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: No representative universal break-even point or lifetime superiority estimate is supplied.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Name supported observers, communicate actionable change and preserve or explicitly revise the promise for each supported baseline.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Obsolete contracts become perpetual and harmful behaviour cannot be corrected.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Unilateral breakage strands consumers despite locally correct new code.
tensions.name: Backwards compatibility versus deliberate breaking change
tensions.nature_of_tension: Existing supported interactions can conflict with needed corrections, new constraints or an unsustainable support horizon.

ESA:ESA-008.bearer: Semantic contracts at component, service or connector boundaries.
ESA:ESA-008.criterion: Express consequential assumptions about state, control, ordering, data meaning, faults and side effects at the interface; check the assumptions actually relied on by both sides.
ESA:ESA-008.trigger: Parts are composed, reused or replaced and nominal signatures do not capture their operating expectations.

ESME:ESME-C026.bearer: Public API, binary interface, protocol, persistent representation and supported versions. Include code, APIs, data, configuration, generated artefacts, builds, release combinations and downstream consumers.
ESME:ESME-C026.criterion: Supported interactions remain valid or consumers have an authorised transition path with explicit limitations.
ESME:ESME-C026.trigger: An interface, schema or protocol is relied on outside the edited component.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: Consumers retain legitimate support promises and feasible continued service.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: Affected parties authorise the changed obligation and a feasible migration, parallel baseline or accepted loss exists.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: Unknown consumers and disputed support promises can constrain release without admitting a universal solution.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Compare variant-indexed constraints; use bounded substitutions, exceptions or a split when necessary, without inventing numeric utility weights.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Portfolio benefit averages away unacceptable losses for a product population.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Every preference becomes a permanent fork and destroys useful commonality.
tensions.name: Commonality versus product-specific quality limits
tensions.nature_of_tension: One common architecture may violate a particular product's quality or externally supplied obligation even when portfolio averages improve.

ESA:ESA-017.bearer: Multi-quality architectural alternatives and external constraints.
ESA:ESA-017.criterion: Separate hard constraints from preferences, compare effects on multiple concerns and make the chosen sacrifice explicit; do not aggregate away unacceptable consequences.
ESA:ESA-017.trigger: Improving one response can worsen another or transfer cost to a different stakeholder.

ESME:ESME-C066.bearer: Cost allocation, support promises and affected stakeholders. A debt item links a concrete design/implementation condition to affected future work and its economic context.
ESME:ESME-C066.criterion: The decision states material shifted costs and how affected parties can act on the information.
ESME:ESME-C066.trigger: A local benefit shifts material work or obligations to other teams, future maintainers or external consumers.

ESPLE:ESPLE-042.bearer: Organisational reach and participant autonomy bound the family; an ecosystem may not be one controlled product line.
ESPLE:ESPLE-042.criterion: Associate externally supplied obligations with affected assets and products, then require appropriate evidence or specialist adjudication before deriving or changing those products.
ESPLE:ESPLE-042.trigger: Supplier conditions, security requirements, licences, regulation or support commitments constrain valid product use.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: The common design satisfies every relevant non-negotiable product limit and its reuse benefit is warranted.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: A product has a genuine incompatible limit or cost burden that the common design cannot adequately accommodate.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: Which trade-offs are legitimately acceptable is not settled by economic or technical modelling alone.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Retain the smallest shared conventions and correspondences that have a consumer; expressly reject mandatory complete 4+1 and feature-tree sufficiency.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: The full view set or plan becomes a proxy for actual knowledge and quality.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Missing explanation obstructs builders, successors or cross-boundary review.
tensions.name: Shared documentation conventions versus concern-driven omission
tensions.nature_of_tension: Common views or production instructions can enable collaboration, while mandatory complete templates can create unused and stale artefacts.

ESA:ESA-021.bearer: Cross-view and description–implementation relations, not visual layout similarity.
ESA:ESA-021.criterion: Identify how entities and relations in different views correspond, then check consequential consistency and the link to implementation/configuration/operation.
ESA:ESA-021.trigger: A decision combines claims from several views or uses a model as evidence about implementation.

ESA:ESA-067.bearer: Design of a system or architectural element through requirement allocation and interfaces.
ESA:ESA-067.criterion: Use prioritised requirements and constraints to select a consequential element, choose design concepts, allocate responsibilities, define interfaces and refine the resulting obligations; revisit earlier choices when evaluation reveals a problem.
ESA:ESA-067.trigger: A system or element needs deliberate architectural decomposition and the significant drivers are understood sufficiently to guide a choice.

ESME:ESME-C017.bearer: Documentation and its source artefact/version. Relevant source, executable traces, build descriptions, documents and human knowledge form different evidence views.
ESME:ESME-C017.criterion: A consumer can use the description to perform the intended task; its version and limits are visible.
ESME:ESME-C017.trigger: A useful explanation is missing, stale or inaccessible to an actual consumer.

ESPLE:ESPLE-020.bearer: Core assets and production plans are bounded by the supported family and its product obligations.
ESPLE:ESPLE-020.criterion: Maintain an actionable, version-related derivation procedure that tells builders which decisions, assets, tools and checks produce a supported product.
ESPLE:ESPLE-020.trigger: Products must be reproduced, handed to another team or built repeatedly from shared assets.

ESPLE:ESPLE-051.bearer: The model represents a declared product family, not every conceivable configuration in the technology domain.
ESPLE:ESPLE-051.criterion: Reject artefact sufficiency; require meaningful features, usable constraints, a relation to realisation and an actual configuration or change consumer.
ESPLE:ESPLE-051.trigger: A diagram, modelling tool or documentation checklist is offered as the evidence of control.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: Real consumers need multiple distinctions or repeatable cross-team construction.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: A simpler checked representation answers the consequential question.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: The maintenance cost and adequacy of a particular documentation set require actual use evidence.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Choose or combine methods by claim, model applicability and missed-effect consequence; restrict configurations when adequate evidence is infeasible.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: A model is expanded indefinitely while unmodelled reality and implementation mapping remain unchecked.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Cheap testing is mistaken for complete correctness or critical interactions are knowingly omitted.
tensions.name: Formal coverage versus proportionate assurance
tensions.nature_of_tension: Stronger modelled coverage can justify important claims but modelling cost, semantic omissions and state growth can dominate.

ESA:ESA-022.criterion: Use a formal description when a consequential property can be expressed and analysed under a tractable model; keep the guarantee, assumptions and implementation mapping explicit.
ESA:ESA-022.trigger: An interaction/configuration property justifies stronger analysis than informal review or testing alone.

ESME:ESME-C040.bearer: Original/changed program, existing test suite and selection dependencies. Bind tests, results, build inputs, artefact identity, environment, deployed versions and relevant data state.
ESME:ESME-C040.criterion: Selected-suite rationale and exclusions are visible; unsupported change kinds trigger fallback.
ESME:ESME-C040.trigger: Running the whole available suite has material cost and sound selection can be justified.

ESME:ESME-C041.bearer: Test set, order, duration estimates and failure relevance. Bind tests, results, build inputs, artefact identity, environment, deployed versions and relevant data state.
ESME:ESME-C041.criterion: The ordering objective is stated and omitted tests, if any, remain known.
ESME:ESME-C041.trigger: A time-constrained test run benefits from earlier actionable failures.

ESPLE:ESPLE-026.bearer: Assurance quantifies over a declared configuration set, not an undefined claim about every possible product.
ESPLE:ESPLE-026.criterion: Preserve variation symbolically or structurally during analysis so common computations are reused, while retaining conditions under which each result applies.
ESPLE:ESPLE-026.trigger: Many products share analyzable structure and the analysis implementation supports their variability semantics.

ESPLE:ESPLE-027.bearer: Assurance quantifies over a declared configuration set, not an undefined claim about every possible product.
ESPLE:ESPLE-027.criterion: State the assumptions and guarantees of a feature or component and discharge compatibility and interaction obligations when composing selected parts.
ESPLE:ESPLE-027.trigger: Stable interfaces and separable properties make local reasoning reusable across products.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: A tractable consequential formal property and demonstrable model-to-implementation mapping exist.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: A scoped risk-informed sample, direct check or constrained state space answers the actual decision more economically.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: The corpora do not provide a universal acceptable risk budget or economically complete abstraction.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Separate intended differences from retained promises and source the oracle independently of the candidate's own output.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Every golden output becomes an immutable specification.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Tests are rewritten merely to make the candidate pass, hiding regressions.
tensions.name: Characterised behaviour versus intended change
tensions.nature_of_tension: Observed behaviour is useful regression evidence but can encode defects or outdated intent.

ESME:ESME-C030.bearer: Pre/post implementation and relevant external context. Use exact pre/post code, language/tool versions and relevant runtime, persistence and external-interface context.
ESME:ESME-C030.criterion: The claimed equivalence is stated relative to the observer and supported by appropriate evidence.
ESME:ESME-C030.trigger: A transformation is justified as non-functional or structure-only.

ESME:ESME-C037.bearer: Legacy outputs, tests, data examples and requirement interpretation. Bind tests, results, build inputs, artefact identity, environment, deployed versions and relevant data state.
ESME:ESME-C037.criterion: Observed behaviour is distinguished from authorised expectations; a golden output is not automatically an immutable obligation.
ESME:ESME-C037.trigger: Important undocumented behaviour makes a change risky.

ESPLE:ESPLE-058.bearer: Evolution preserves or explicitly revises obligations of supported products, not just the newest family model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-058.criterion: Reject the equivalence; preserve or explicitly change feature intent and verify the actual migrated product's obligations.
ESPLE:ESPLE-058.trigger: Compatibility is asserted solely because names or model-level product sets did not change.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: The observer corresponds to a legitimately retained commitment.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: An authorised change explicitly revises the relevant outcome while retaining independent obligations.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: Disputed historical intent cannot be recovered from observation alone.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Permit only justified transitions with observed realisation and state/effect-aware recovery; use safe reconfiguration phases or earlier binding where appropriate.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Valid endpoint selection is used to justify unsafe or irreversible transitions.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: All useful runtime adaptation is prohibited even where a bounded safe protocol exists.
tensions.name: Runtime flexibility versus transition and recovery assurance
tensions.nature_of_tension: Late-bound choices respond to context but introduce intermediate states and can remove repair options.

ESA:ESA-046.bearer: Runtime architectural configurations, monitors, model and control actions.
ESA:ESA-046.criterion: Observe the running system, interpret observations in an architecture model, choose among allowed changes and execute them through available effectors; keep system-specific translation explicit.
ESA:ESA-046.trigger: Operating variation warrants runtime reconfiguration and appropriate actions are available.

ESME:ESME-C049.bearer: The remaining recovery and forward-repair options for the actual effect history.
ESME:ESME-C049.criterion: At the consequential action boundary, the promised remaining recovery/containment route is feasible for the relevant state, or the residual loss is explicitly accepted by the appropriate decision maker.
ESME:ESME-C049.trigger: A change or exposure can leave consequential state or lose an existing recovery option.

ESPLE:ESPLE-013.bearer: Realisation choices serve the selected family scope rather than requiring all products to share one implementation technique.
ESPLE:ESPLE-013.criterion: Choose a binding time for each variation by weighing when information becomes available against footprint, assurance, deployment and runtime transition costs.
ESPLE:ESPLE-013.trigger: A variation point is introduced or its resolution time changes.

ESPLE:ESPLE-043.bearer: Dynamic and AI-assisted variants remain bounded by a declared family; broader ecosystem derivatives may require a different organisational model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-043.criterion: Model permitted runtime configurations, relevant context and the mapping from observations to proposed reconfiguration; connect the decision to actual actuators and feedback.
ESPLE:ESPLE-043.trigger: A product must change its selected capabilities during execution as conditions change.

ESPLE:ESPLE-044.bearer: Dynamic and AI-assisted variants remain bounded by a declared family; broader ecosystem derivatives may require a different organisational model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-044.criterion: Check the transition path, quiescence or state transfer and actual controllability; preserve safety requirements throughout the operating phase or enter a separately justified safe reconfiguration phase.
ESPLE:ESPLE-044.trigger: Features or components are rebound while the system is operating.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: A real operational need cannot be met adequately by earlier binding and the action envelope is established.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: Live transfer or recovery cannot be adequately assured, or static/restart operation is cheaper and adequate.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: Adequate plant/observer models and open-world effects remain context-specific.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Compare complete bounded workflows and delegate only the supported object/action envelope; retain unresolved long-horizon and replacement claims.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Fluent output and benchmark passage are promoted into autonomous lifecycle stewardship.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: An adverse result from one task becomes a universal prohibition of useful assistance.
tensions.name: Automation speed versus acceptance and total cost
tensions.nature_of_tension: Faster suggestions can increase validation, comprehension or later support costs and cannot authorise their own application.

ESA:ESA-054.bearer: AI-produced architectural representations, options, risk analyses and boundary proposals.
ESA:ESA-054.criterion: Use generated alternatives, descriptions or risk suggestions as candidates; independently check their evidence, semantics, metrics and fit to the actual system before relying on them.
ESA:ESA-054.trigger: AI assistance could reduce search/drafting effort and adequate validation is available.

ESME:ESME-C083.bearer: Generated diff, issue interpretation, tests, harness and environment. Identify issue text, reference patch, model/tool version, prompt, dataset, harness, repository state and non-code dependencies.
ESME:ESME-C083.criterion: Accepted claims identify repaired obligations and residual uncertainty; unsupported additions are removed or authorised.
ESME:ESME-C083.trigger: A repair or evolution suggestion is generated by a search system, model or agent.

ESME:ESME-C087.bearer: Human tasks, model calls, review effort, compute and accepted outcomes. Identify issue text, reference patch, model/tool version, prompt, dataset, harness, repository state and non-code dependencies.
ESME:ESME-C087.criterion: The benefit claim includes relevant total work and uncertainty rather than generation speed alone.
ESME:ESME-C087.trigger: Automation adoption is justified as saving maintenance effort or increasing useful output.

ESME:ESME-C094.bearer: The acceptance decision and execution powers for a concrete intervention.
ESME:ESME-C094.criterion: The real acceptance and action stay within the delegated object, scope and capability; generated insight or test success does not enlarge them.
ESME:ESME-C094.trigger: An actor or automated tool proposes, accepts or executes a change, especially when these functions cross authority boundaries.

ESPLE:ESPLE-028.bearer: Assurance quantifies over a declared configuration set, not an undefined claim about every possible product.
ESPLE:ESPLE-028.criterion: Check the actual derived artefacts against the selected product obligations and operating context, reusing family evidence only where its premises apply.
ESPLE:ESPLE-028.trigger: A product is delivered, deployed or materially changed.

ESPLE:ESPLE-047.bearer: Dynamic and AI-assisted variants remain bounded by a declared family; broader ecosystem derivatives may require a different organisational model.
ESPLE:ESPLE-047.criterion: Treat generated changes as proposals; validate syntax, constraints, semantic intent, realisation and product obligations using appropriate independent checks before acceptance.
ESPLE:ESPLE-047.trigger: Learned tools assist feature modelling, configuration advice, migration or variant generation.

tensions.side_a_justified_when: Bounded assistance reduces full task burden with adequate output evidence.
tensions.side_b_justified_when: Verification, uncertainty or external-action risk exceeds the apparent generation benefit.
tensions.simultaneous_satisfaction: Conditionally possible by the bounded synthesis; where the real obligations or authorities conflict irreducibly, narrow the claim, negotiate, select an alternative or decline the action rather than average them.
tensions.unresolved_remainder: No general unattended capability or superior lifecycle regeneration result is established by these inputs.

tensions.bounded_synthesis: Assess the combined arrangement, preserve the protected outcome, and consolidate, substitute or retire only with a residual-obligation account.
tensions.evidence_boundary: Analytical comparison of the frozen records, not new source access, independent replication, target adoption, or empirical validation of the composed system. The conditional trade-off is a synthesis judgment, not a measured optimum.
tensions.failure_universalising_a: Assurance accumulates without consumers, suppressing useful work and hiding conflicting rules.
tensions.failure_universalising_b: Cost cutting removes rare but necessary protection and calls that proportionality.
tensions.name: Individually justified controls versus combined burden
tensions.nature_of_tension: Several local controls can duplicate evidence, conflict or consume the capacity needed to protect the system.

ESA:ESA-028.bearer: Multi-quality evaluation of an architectural candidate.
ESA:ESA-028.criterion: Bring business/mission drivers, architecture and quality scenarios into a structured review to identify assumptions, risks, sensitivity points and trade-offs that need a decision.
ESA:ESA-028.trigger: Several consequential qualities interact and missing assumptions justify a facilitated multi-stakeholder review.

ESA:ESA-056.bearer: Architecture methods and governance arrangements applied to a particular system.
ESA:ESA-056.criterion: Keep only the architectural control, artefact or coordination mechanism whose consumer and avoided risk justify its cost; choose the smallest coherent arrangement and retire obsolete controls.
ESA:ESA-056.trigger: Architecture work imposes review, documentation, modelling or coordination cost.

ESME:ESME-C039.bearer: The provenance and scope of the observation or acceptance criterion.
